name: Mien luon
summary: Mien luon is eel with glass noodles. In Hanoi it is served cold or stir-fried, in soup, and also as congee and spring rolls.
origin: Hanoi. Michelin’s 2025 notes put the bowl in the Old Quarter and name a shop that has cooked it for nearly 40 years.
howToEat: Eel comes cold or stir-fried, with vermicelli in soup. The same kitchens also serve eel congee and eel spring rolls.
The 2024 city tour describes one bowl with greens, crushed peanuts, and fried shallots.
where: Miến Lươn Chân Cầm is in the Old Quarter, on the 2025 Bib Gourmand list. Miến Lươn Đông Thịnh is the eel shop the 2024 tour names, also a Bib Gourmand. The hour at both is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mien luon — Hanoi eel and glass noodles
seoDescription: Mien luon in Hanoi is eel with glass noodles, in soup or stir-fried, plus eel congee and spring rolls. Chân Cầm and Đông Thịnh are the doors the Michelin notes name.
